description: For an AGENCY: draft a proposal of Google Business Profile optimizations for one of its clients, to send with send_optimization_proposal. By default it starts from our audit of the client's live profile (its failing and warning checks, each with what we found and the fix). Add your own items with items: [{title, why, change}] — title is the short name, why is why it matters to the owner, change is exactly what will change on the profile. Up to 15 items. Set from_audit: false to send only your own. Nothing is sent yet: show the agency the list and let them edit it before sending.

client.description: The client's business name (or part of it) or id.

intro.description: A short note from the agency at the top.

name: draft_optimization_proposal
title: Draft Google profile optimizations to propose to a client
